description: Real-time trending tokens across Solana, Base, BSC and Ethereum ranked by swaps, volume or market cap. Includes sniper-critical data: honeypot flag, bundler rate, rug ratio, smart-degen count, dev-team hold rate, top-10 holder concentration, entrapment ratio and sniper count. Agents use this to discover newly launched tokens and assess risk before sniping. Powered by GMGN. 0.05 USDC per call via x402.

filters.description: Comma-separated: not_honeypot, verified, renounced, has_social, not_wash_trading

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
